function_call.arguments: "{\"PythonCode\":\"# Calculate the dimensions for the U-shaped profile\\n# Total width: 70mm, height: 40mm, web thickness: 5mm\\n# The U-shape consists of two flanges and a web\\n# Flange width: (70mm - 5mm) / 2 = 32.5mm each\\nflange_width = (70 - 5) / 2\\nflange_height = 40\\nweb_thickness = 5\\nweb_height = 40\\nlength = 450\\n\\n# Base points for the flanges and web\\n# Flange 1: x=0, y=0, z=0\\n# Web: x=32.5, y=0, z=0\\n# Flange 2: x=32.5 + 5 = 37.5, y=0, z=0\\n\\n# Dimensions for the blocks\\nx_sizes = [flange_width, web_thickness, flange_width]\\ny_sizes = [length, length, length]\\nz_sizes = [flange_height, web_height, flange_height]\\n\\n# Positions for the blocks\\nx_positions = [0, flange_width, flange_width + web_thickness]\\ny_positions = [0, 0, 0]\\nz_positions = [0, 0, 0]\\n\\n# Subtraction flags (all False for initial creation)\\nsubtraction_flags = [False, False, False]\\n\\n# Return the calculated values\\n{\\n    \\\"x_sizes\\\": x_sizes,\\n    \\\"y_sizes\\\": y_sizes,\\n    \\\"z_sizes\\\": z_sizes,\\n    \\\"x_positions\\\": x_positions,\\n    \\\"y_positions\\\": y_positions,\\n    \\\"z_positions\\\": z_positions,\\n    \\\"subtraction_flags\\\": subtraction_flags\\n}\"}"

{"PythonCode":"# Calculate the dimensions for the U-shaped profile
# Total width: 70mm, height: 40mm, web thickness: 5mm
# The U-shape consists of two flanges and a web
# Flange width: (70mm - 5mm) / 2 = 32.5mm each
flange_width = (70 - 5) / 2
flange_height = 40
web_thickness = 5
web_height = 40
length = 450

# Base points for the flanges and web
# Flange 1: x=0, y=0, z=0
# Web: x=32.5, y=0, z=0
# Flange 2: x=32.5 + 5 = 37.5, y=0, z=0

# Dimensions for the blocks
x_sizes = [flange_width, web_thickness, flange_width]
y_sizes = [length, length, length]
z_sizes = [flange_height, web_height, flange_height]

# Positions for the blocks
x_positions = [0, flange_width, flange_width + web_thickness]
y_positions = [0, 0, 0]
z_positions = [0, 0, 0]

# Subtraction flags (all False for initial creation)
subtraction_flags = [False, False, False]

# Return the calculated values
{
    "x_sizes": x_sizes,
    "y_sizes": y_sizes,
    "z_sizes": z_sizes,
    "x_positions": x_positions,
    "y_positions": y_positions,
    "z_positions": z_positions,
    "subtraction_flags": subtraction_flags
}"}
